rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §12's stated root cause matches the code (pick() calls the snapshotter at reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:396 before `_declared_difficulty` at :419, and live dispatch at reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:494 builds the `PickRequest` with no capability, so the snapshot sees none), the mechanism produces its done-when (the block is built by the scan §3 extends, keyed on the request's requirement), and the caller the fix rests on — `pick()` — is named and is the live dispatch path.
